ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 95% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels with 5% high-intensity (white) localized spots and tip margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid dark pigmentation across the entire ventral surface. Discrete, high-contrast white circular spots (diameter approx. 5-10 pixels) are scattered across both lobes. High-intensity white pigmentation is localized at the distal tips and along portions of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 70 degrees; the apex depth occupies approximately 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration across the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 3 to 15 pixels, showing significant irregularity particularly on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the upper margins of both lobes, ending in an acute upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; primary clusters identified in the mid-section of the left lobe and lower-medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the center towards the upper trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular serration and small semi-circular indentations along the trailing edge suggestive of tissue loss; widespread white circular scars consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric jagged profile of the trailing edge where the left lobe exhibits deeper, more frequent serration peaks than the right lobe.
